Prefer pinned image-build content. A PR needing additional content is held/reported individually without broader egress.

openObligations.detail: E/integrator must select immutable image/build pins for source-only aliases: Node 20, Node ^20.9 and >=18, Python 3.12/3.13, JDK 11/25, and SDK command-line/build tools. Source declarations are frozen verbatim; they are not exact patch versions or smoke evidence.

W3-4 explicitly requires Go but no reviewed repository has a go.mod/go.sum or setup-go pin at the inspected revisions. Driver must settle an exact supported Go version; absence is not an allowed limitation. Keep W3-4 incomplete until pinned and smoke-tested.

Every required entry has availability unknown: this read-only package ran no toolchain, build, install or smoke test. E/integration must provision and smoke every required toolchain; a failure remains an open obligation, never an accepted limitation.

E must select and verify digest-pinned non-root sidecars: Postgres 16/17, Redis (7 and floating alpine), Azurite, Prometheus 3.15.0, Grafana 13.2.3 OTel Collector 0.162.0 and Nginx (passkey fixture, floating alpine). Existing Docker tags are observations, not launcher image authority.

C/integration must verify metadata, tarballs and redirects through the frozen explicit hostname list. Defaults are endpoint mappings, not observed successful downloads. GitHub, release CDNs, Foojay and browser/Prisma binaries are not blanket-allowlisted.

Android SDK API 37, Gradle 9.6.0, Kotlin 2.2.10 and AGP 9.4.1 are required. Provision SDK/JDK/Gradle contents in the image; native Android Linux compilation/unit tests cannot be waived as Swift-on-Linux. No emulator or device execution was requested or proved.

The reviewed agent product image pins extra agent/analyzer/browser tools and installs floating Rust, Foundry, OpenTofu, node/npm. Full product-image-tools.json is private run evidence. These are product build inputs, not permission to run nested Docker/agents. Driver/E must decide which are required for Python/static review tests; every required unpinned tool needs an exact pin.

DeFi-Dashboard, contracts and metrics-dashboard are outside continuity but have 90-day PR discovery evidence (contracts also a private monorepo gitlink). Driver must confirm future lane membership. Personal/upstream discoveries are listed as exclusions, not silently discarded.

Cloud/deployment workflows reference Azure and other live APIs. No credentials, production databases, RPCs or deployment operations are approved for the sandbox. Driver must select isolated test subsets/mocks; a required isolated service stays an obligation and cannot be renamed a limitation.

D/integration must validate explicit ext4 inode count and bytes against a fresh largest dependency install inside containment. Existing tree sizing does not measure Rust builds, Android/Gradle transitive artifacts or two-run host capacity. Floor is guidance, not a proven cap.

contracts has public gitlinks lib/forge-std at 8e40513d678f392f398620b3ef2b418648b33e89 and lib/openzeppelin-contracts at fcbae5394ae8ad52d8e580a3477db99814b9d565. E must prebuild pinned content without running its scripts. No .gitmodules URL mapping is tracked in this clone; upstream identities are inferred from names/foundry.lock and need immutable-tree confirmation. Private monorepo contracts gitlink stays restricted. Soldeer lock contains four entries but foundry.toml declares five: @solarity-solidity-lib 2.7.6 is not locked; do not guess its resolved artifact.

inodeSizing.method: Round a 4x margin over largest measured directory-entry count (154801) up to power of two; do not assume host hardlinks survive export. Set ext4 inode count explicitly (mkfs.ext4 -N), validate with dumpe2fs/tune2fs in D. No filesystem formatted in A.
inodeSizing.hostMemoryDiskBudget: Not measured by A; B/D/E/integration own actual host caps and two-run budget.
